symbols.name: field width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two fields being interchanged, a count of bit positions.
symbols.quote: Write $\rho$ for the field width, the number of bits in each of the two fields being interchanged.

relations.predicate: is a run of bits in
relations.quote: An address field is a run of bits in the [address](address.md) of an array, consecutive in position, and it is the unit that an address interchange exchanges with another field of the same width.
Each address field is moved by a [permutation](permutation.md) of addresses, because the interchange exchanges only the fields and not the entries' values.
